ageing_relevance.rationale: ADM has moderate ageing-literature share and links to age-related cardiovascular, renal and metabolic disease. It is one of the GrimAge plasma-protein surrogates, but that is a methylation estimate, not measured protein, and the schizophrenia effect was explained by smoking.

evidence.value: One of seven plasma proteins whose DNA-methylation surrogates make up GrimAge

background_knowledge: Circulating MR-proADM is a known prognostic marker of mortality and cardiovascular risk (not returned by the tools).

mechanism.rationale: ADM is a well-characterised vasoactive peptide hormone. Its link to ageing is correlative. The direction is ambiguous: raised levels mark disease, but ADM signalling is also vasoprotective.

evidence.value: Peptide hormone that act as potent hypotensive and vasodilatator agents by inhibiting catecholamine secretion from sympathetic nerve endings and adrenal chromaffin cells (PubMed:10588445, PubMed:9578982). Acts as a ligand for MRGPRX2 receptor in mast cells (PubMed:15823563, PubMed:34789875)

background_knowledge: ADM signals through CALCRL/RAMP receptors and has protective cardiovascular and endothelial effects.
Whether the elevated levels are causal or compensatory is unresolved.

tractability.rationale: As a secreted peptide it is tractable to antibodies, with an advanced clinical antibody. Small-molecule tractability evidence is also present (ligand structures, high-quality ligands). There is no approved drug.

safety.rationale: Open Targets lists no safety liabilities, but absence of data is not evidence of safety. ADM is a vasodilator with important physiological roles, so chronic inhibition could carry risk.
background_knowledge: Adm knockout mice are embryonic lethal with cardiovascular and lymphatic defects.
Chronic suppression could affect blood pressure and vascular integrity.

clinical_precedence.rationale: One antibody, enibarcimab, has reached Phase 2/3. There is no approved drug. I scored it at 3 because Phase 3 completion is not shown.
background_knowledge: Enibarcimab is also known as adrecizumab and has been tested in acute indications such as septic shock. It is not an ageing indication.

assessment.summary: ADM (adrenomedullin) is a secreted vasoactive peptide.
